items.criterion: An unlisted talent is absent from the public roster payload.
items.judgment: The roster payload carries no noor-vasquez entry.
items.evidence: The roster payload with no session.

items.criterion: An unlisted talent answers not found at its own address for a visitor.
items.judgment: The direct read of noor-vasquez is refused.
items.evidence: The direct read status with no session.

items.criterion: An unlisted work is absent from the public index payload.
items.judgment: The index payload carries no the-quiet-room entry.
items.evidence: The index payload with no session.

items.criterion: The media address of an unlisted record is refused to a caller holding its id.
items.judgment: The media read for the unlisted poster is not found.
items.evidence: The media read status with no session.

items.criterion: The media address of a published record renders its generated object.
items.judgment: The media read answers with a body.
items.evidence: The media read status and body length.

items.criterion: Publishing stamps the record and makes it reachable at its own address.
items.judgment: The stamped field is set and the address answers.
items.evidence: The publish response and the later direct read.

items.criterion: Unlisting removes the record from the roster and from its own address at once.
items.judgment: The roster loses the entry and the address is refused.
items.evidence: The roster payload and the direct read after unlisting.

items.criterion: A record whose poster carries an empty written alternative cannot be published.
items.judgment: The publish call is refused and the stored row stays unlisted.
items.evidence: The publish status and the stored row.

items.criterion: Displayed ordinals run contiguously from the first, zero padded to three digits.
items.judgment: The index ordinals are a gapless zero padded sequence.
items.evidence: The ordinals on the index payload.

items.criterion: Unlisting a work leaves the remaining ordinals contiguous.
items.judgment: The index ordinals close over the withdrawn record.
items.evidence: The ordinals before and after the record is withdrawn.

items.criterion: The discipline set is the disciplines of published talent in first appearance order.
items.judgment: The discipline payload names the two seeded disciplines in order.
items.evidence: The discipline payload.

items.criterion: Publishing a talent carrying a new discipline adds that discipline to the set.
items.judgment: The discipline payload grows and shrinks with the talent.
items.evidence: The discipline payload before and after publishing.

items.criterion: A producer of one house is refused at every studio address of another house.
items.judgment: Every cross-house studio call is denied.
items.evidence: The status of each cross-house studio call.

items.criterion: A cross-house studio read answers as it would for a record that does not exist.
items.judgment: The cross-house read is not found and names nothing.
items.evidence: The cross-house read status and body.

items.criterion: A session carrying the lesser role is refused at every studio address.
items.judgment: Every studio call from that session is denied.
items.evidence: The status of each studio call from that session.

items.criterion: A preview token opens the one record it was minted for.
items.judgment: The preview answers with that record.
items.evidence: The preview response body.

items.criterion: The preview address reveals nothing to a caller without the producer session.
items.judgment: The preview is refused and names no record.
items.evidence: The preview status and body for each session.

items.criterion: An account created through open signup carries the lesser role and no house.
items.judgment: The signup response carries the lesser role whatever the request asked for.
items.evidence: The signup response body.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous creates of one slug leave exactly one stored record.
items.judgment: One create is accepted, one refused, and one row exists.
items.evidence: The two create statuses and the stored row count.

items.criterion: A deliberately moved slug leaves the old address answering permanently.
items.judgment: The old address still resolves and a redirect row exists.
items.evidence: The old address status and the redirect row.

items.criterion: A talent's selected work matches the credits that name that talent.
items.judgment: The listed works and the credit rows agree in number.
items.evidence: The talent payload and the credit rows.
